{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue == 999999.99) and refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
valid_orders = sales[
    (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Filter for converted customers (converted == 1)
converted_customers = valid_orders[valid_orders['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data)
converted_customers_valid_age = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = converted_customers_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(mean_age_converted)"}
